profile.headline: Software Development Engineer II at Amazon | Berkeley Computer Science | Berkeley Statistics
profile.summary: Software Development Engineer at AWS who completed undergrad at University of California, Berkeley with majors in Computer Science and Statistics. Proactive and outgoing student eager to learn more about software and business development. Seeking professional development and exposure to the different fields of technology and innovation. Quick to adapt situations and detail-oriented.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Engineering · Software Infrastructure · Software Engineering · Computer Science · Coding Experience

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Working with Professor Alice Agogino on machine learning for Squishy Robotics, a spinoff from research between University of California, Berkeley and NASA producing rapidly deployable mobile sensing robots for disaster rescue, remote monitoring and space exploration

positions.title: Academic Development Mentor
positions.description: Mentored team of 5 working on a data science project to build visualizations based on college nutritional data. Organized and executed a workshop for an audience of over 100 middle-schoolers to introduce them to data science.

positions.title: Culture Committee
positions.description: Planning and execution of orientation activities for ~40 pax such as Welcome Night, Fall Retreat and so on. Facilitation of bonding activities to integrate new members into the community and strengthen relationships within club. Host data science training sessions for club members.

positions.title: Tech Committee
positions.description: Web Development and React through personal projects and maintenance of DSS website.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: Completed a machine learning project using decision tree packages from scikit-learn to classify data to predict MBTI personality types based on online behaviour. Presented the project at the Berkeley Data Science Symposium to an audience of 80 other data-scientists.

positions.title: iOS Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Built 3 iOS full-stack mobile applications in the training program using Auto Layout in Swift and UIKit for frontend development and incorporated Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore for backend storage and integration.
Constructed a Pokédex application with a collection view of 800 Pokémon loaded with concurrent image fetching using Grand Central Dispatch and a navigation bar containing a search bar and a button to toggle between view layouts.
Implemented an event planning application for a school organization with user login and signup pages linked to account comprising of list of upcoming events with more details available upon tap and information dynamically updated.

positions.title: Executive Committee (Treasurer)
positions.description:
Evaluating potential value-add of projects to ensure efficient usage of funds. Allocating budget and directing expenses of SSA. 
Facilitating orientation and networking amongst overseas Singaporean students. 
Planning and executing Fall Retreat for >35 Singaporean students in UC Berkeley.

positions.title: Info-comm, Media & Digitalisation Intern
positions.description:
Received Exceeded Expectations assessments from Reporting Officer and Deputy Director.

Spearheaded automation of database compilation project. Built a web-scraper using Beautiful Soup, Selenium and Pandas to compile a database of information on 15,000+ tech companies in Singapore for the ICM & Digitalization division. Cut compilation time by 30%.

Identified key trends and developments in the quantum computing market. Conducted an in-depth analysis of quantum computing mechanics and potential commercial value. Presented findings and proposed strategies for Singaporean government to assist the technological transition to leadership team and high-level executives.

Learnt about the various supports and grants available to Artificial Intelligence startups and assisted in meetings to discuss business strategy in response to Covid-19.

positions.title: Middle East and Africa Intern
positions.description: Assisted Middle East and Africa team in organization of Africa-Singapore Business Forum by liaising with business owners and startup founders, researching and preparing write-ups on the African market. Processed trade data between South Africa and South East Asia and helped to prepare a presentation on sourcing from South Africa. Aided in research on trade financing for Singaporean startups and learnt about the various methods of raising capital for expansion of trade overseas. Learnt about the various supports and grants available to startups and assisted in meetings with startup teams to discuss business strategy in response to Covid-19.
